'''Quadrant L-42''' was a region in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Cho'pa'ailor]] operated a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] repair shop in Quadrant L-42.<ref name="UABS" />
